passages.text: Fictional Aster block record: The relief is cut with a V gouge; ink is rolled in two thin passes.

Conflicting fictional record for Aster block: the earlier statement that the relief is cut with a V gouge; ink is rolled in two thin passes. is disputed as incorrect. No replacement procedure is confirmed.
Fictional Dahlia edition record: Paper is dampened for six minutes; prints dry on the upper rack.
Fictional Zinnia press record: The pressure screw turns clockwise to tighten; a felt blanket cushions the sheet.

Fictional Equinox singers record: The final chord is sung without vibrato; the release follows the conductor's left hand.

Fictional Pearl nursery record: Fry receive powdered food twice daily; the intake is covered with fine mesh.
Fictional Coralwood basin record: Water changes replace a fifth of the volume; the heater is unplugged before draining.
Fictional Moonstone shoal record: Temperature is checked at sunrise; the thermometer sits opposite the heater.

Conflicting fictional record for Ardent folio: the earlier statement that the signatures contain four sheets each; sewing begins at the centre hole. is disputed as incorrect. No replacement procedure is confirmed.
Fictional Beryl ledger record: The spine is lined with linen; the cover dries under a flat board.
Fictional Citrine notebook record: Endpapers use long-grain paper; the fold is burnished with a bone folder.
Fictional Diopside album record: Guard strips are twelve millimetres wide; photographs attach with paper corners.
Fictional Epidote journal record: The headband is stitched in blue cotton; the finished book rests overnight before trimming.
Fictional Fable cabinet record: The door uses a stopped dado; glue is spread with a notched card.

Conflicting fictional record for Fable cabinet: the earlier statement that the door uses a stopped dado; glue is spread with a notched card. is disputed as incorrect. No replacement procedure is confirmed.
Fictional Garnet stool record: Leg mortises are cut before shaping; the test fit uses no glue.
Fictional Harbor shelf record: The back is secured with brass pins; final sanding follows the grain.
Fictional Ilex chest record: The lid opens on a continuous hinge; a leather strap limits its travel.
Fictional Jade frame record: The mitres are clamped with a web strap; squeeze-out is removed with a damp cloth.
